schemaDescription: Join Myntmore as a Content Marketing Strategist Intern in BKC, Mumbai. Write and strategize high-impact LinkedIn content for founders and CXOs. 1-year commitment, work from office.
aboutIntro: Your role isn't just writing, it's researching, analysing, and crafting the best posts on entrepreneurship, storytelling, and marketing. Think about the posts that go viral, that make people stop scrolling and engage. That's what we're aiming for. You'll dive into the best content out there and make it even better. Your mission: make our clients' posts explode on LinkedIn.
aboutCalloutText: You will study top-performing posts on LinkedIn, Twitter, and other platforms. You'll figure out why they worked: the hooks, the formatting, the storytelling. Then, you'll apply those insights to create original, high-performing content for our clients. No generic posts, no AI-generated fluff. Pure, well-crafted, value-driven writing that builds real personal brands.

responsibilities.title: Content Research & Writing
responsibilities.desc: Write high-quality, insight-driven content for founders, CXOs, and leaders on LinkedIn. Convert briefs and voice notes into impactful storytelling and strategic posts.

responsibilities.title: Voice & Positioning
responsibilities.desc: Build and maintain distinct voices for multiple clients. Understand tone, positioning, and the purpose behind every post, whether it's engagement, visibility, or lead-gen.

responsibilities.title: Trend Spotting & Deconstruction
responsibilities.desc: Analyse high-performing LinkedIn posts and frameworks. Spot patterns in hooks, pacing, formatting, and CTAs, and adapt them across different client industries.

responsibilities.title: Distribution & Formatting
responsibilities.desc: Format posts for maximum dwell time and mobile readability on LinkedIn: line breaks, hooks, visual rhythm, carousels, and image attachments.

responsibilities.title: Engagement & Optimisation
responsibilities.desc: Track post metrics (impressions, comments, profile visits) and continuously improve based on what resonates with target audiences.

whoYouAre.label: Writing Instinct
whoYouAre.desc: You can write short, punchy, persuasive copy that feels human, not robotic

whoYouAre.label: LinkedIn Fluent
whoYouAre.desc: You understand how LinkedIn's feed works: what gets read, what gets skipped, and what triggers engagement

whoYouAre.label: Fast Learner
whoYouAre.desc: You can absorb a founder's perspective on an industry in 30 minutes and turn it into 5 strong post angles

whoYouAre.label: Detail-Oriented
whoYouAre.desc: Clean grammar, tight phrasing, zero typos

whoYouAre.label: Feedback-Friendly
whoYouAre.desc: You take edits and critique in stride; you iterate fast without getting attached to drafts

whoYouAre.label: Long-Term Mindset
whoYouAre.desc: You're committing for at least 1 year: personal branding is a compounding game, and so is the skill of writing for CXOs

whoYouAre.label: Ambitious
whoYouAre.desc: You want your writing to be read by tens of thousands of business leaders every week

whyJoin: You'll learn executive positioning, thought-leadership ghostwriting, and content-led demand generation from people who do it every day for multiple high-profile clients. Work from our BKC office in Mumbai with performance incentives on posts that hit engagement and lead milestones.
